featured.name: Learning Center
featured.tagline: Full-stack employee training platform on NetSuite
featured.description: An interactive training platform that enables employees to complete courses with bilingual content, take quizzes with server-side grading, and track their progress. Built as a React SPA served through a NetSuite SuiteLet with a SuiteScript backend handling data persistence and quiz validation.
features: Bilingual content delivery (EN/FR) with context-based i18n
Quiz system with server-side grading — answers never sent to the client
Per-user progress tracking via NetSuite custom records
Course prerequisites and sequential section unlocking
Dev mode with localStorage mock for local development

featured.name: Extreme SuiteLets
featured.description: A collection of custom SuiteLet applications that extend NetSuite's capabilities. These range from real-time KPI dashboards to third-party integration monitors, data tools, and workflow automation interfaces.
features: Real-time warehouse and company KPI dashboards
HighJump WMS integration monitoring and recovery
Product image bulk downloader with ZIP export
Support case Kanban board with drag-and-drop
